series.name: Eastbound (citybound, morning peak)
series.evidence: Tube counter 210's direction labels flip each time the tubes are reinstalled after an outage: weekly workday AM share (7-9h vs 17-19h) of 251 is 0.72-0.84 until 2022-06-06, 0.18-0.27 from the 2022-07-27 restart to the week of 2022-10-31, 0.70-0.85 from the 2022-11-08 restart to week 2024-10-14, and 0.12-0.24 from the 2024-10-18 restart to now; 253 mirrors it. Counter 108 (2021) did not flip (79 AM share 0.51-0.85 throughout) and matches the following 2022 flow in level and profile (Dec 2021 104-109/day, Jan-Feb 2022 94-99/day). The restart days' pre-restart hours are zeros already set missing.

useful: zeros(counter=True): listed every stretch where the whole counter read 0, with daytime hours and usual bikes
network: separated the feed-wide 2025-10-23 outage from counter-level faults
daily+weather: ruled out rain as the cause of multi-day zeros and explained short single-direction zeros on wet days
hourly: showed matching direction profiles across the counter change
raw: warning flags on the zero days
not_useful: compare: neighbouring long-running sites had too few complete common weeks around the counter change
doubled/duplicates/spikes: only isolated single-slot items, nothing systematic
improve: zeros: add a flag for whether the other direction was also near zero and a count of warning days inside each stretch
compare: allow weeks with incomplete days at the neighbour (scaled) so ratios exist around a counter change
directions/hourly: a per-week AM-vs-PM peak share per direction would make label swaps obvious; I missed them by checking the profile only at the counter change
add: a per-stretch table merging zeros with daily totals of each direction, rain, and network zero_sites, to triage outages in one call

summary: Site 174 (Railway Ave, Stanmore) is a bidirectional tube count: counter 108 (2021) was replaced by 210 (2022 onward) at matching levels, but 210's direction labels flip at the tube reinstallations of 2022-07-27, 2022-11-08 and 2024-10-18, so the East and West series switch between 251 and 253 on those dates. Recurring whole-counter dropouts to exact 0 (longest 7 June-27 July 2022, several of 1-8 days, one feed-wide day) are set missing, and 2022-02-19 was counted twice (every count even) and is halved.
